body.message:
Yes, the 2BR at MAG 318 is available from May 1st.

On the 6-month question, our rates are confirmed in 3-month blocks. The current rate is AED 7,900/month, all-inclusive, covering water, electricity, and internet. We can lock that in for the first 3 months, and for the following 3 months the rate will depend on the season at that point.

Want to arrange a viewing, or shall we get things started for May 1st?
